text_en: Praise the Lord ! Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty firmament!
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请众在上主的圣所赞美他， 请众在壮丽的苍天赞美他！

text_en: Praise him for his mighty deeds; praise him according to his surpassing greatness!
text_cn: 请众为了上主的丰功伟业而赞美他， 请众为了上主的无限伟大而赞美他！

text_en: Praise him with trumpet sound; praise him with lute and harp!
text_cn: 请众吹起号角赞美他， 请众弹琴奏瑟赞美他！

text_en: Praise him with tambourine and dance; praise him with strings and pipe!
text_cn: 请众敲鼓舞蹈赞美他， 请众拉弦吹笛赞美他！

text_en: Praise him with clanging cymbals; praise him with loud clashing cymbals!
text_cn: 请众以声洪的铙钹赞美他， 请众以响亮的铙钹赞美他！

text_en: Let everything that breathes praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 一切有气息的，请赞美上主！ 亚肋路亚。
